<?php
/**
 * Mobile Backend API v2.3
 * Feature Flag Configuration Service
 * 
 * Handles device registration and feature flag sync for mobile clients.
 * Supports XML and JSON payloads for backward compatibility.
 */

namespace App\Api\Mobile;

use App\Config\FeatureFlags;
use App\Security\InputValidator;
use App\Logging\AuditLogger;

class DeviceConfigController
{
    private $featureFlags;
    private $validator;
    private $logger;
    private $parserOptions;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->featureFlags = new FeatureFlags();
        $this->validator = new InputValidator();
        $this->logger = new AuditLogger();
        $this->parserOptions = $this->initParserOptions();
    }

    /**
     * Initialize XML parser security options based on feature flags.
     * Uses defense-in-depth: multiple layers of protection.
     */
    private function initParserOptions(): array
    {
        $options = [
            'encoding' => 'UTF-8',
            'max_depth' => 10,
            'max_size' => 65536,
            'allow_dtd' => false,
            'network_access' => false,
        ];

        // Feature flag: legacy_xml_compat enables broader XML support
        // for older clients (Android < 5.0) that send DTD declarations
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('legacy_xml_compat')) {
            $options['allow_dtd'] = true;
            // Even with DTD allowed, we disable external entities
            $options['substitute_entities'] = false;
        }

        return $options;
    }

    /**
     * POST /api/v2/device/config
     * Accepts device configuration and returns feature flags.
     */
    public function syncDeviceConfig(): array
    {
        $contentType = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? 'application/json';
        $rawBody = file_get_contents('php://input');

        if (strlen($rawBody) > $this->parserOptions['max_size']) {
            return $this->errorResponse(413, 'Payload too large');
        }

        if (strpos($contentType, 'xml') !== false) {
            $deviceData = $this->parseXmlPayload($rawBody);
        } else {
            $deviceData = $this->parseJsonPayload($rawBody);
        }

        if ($deviceData === null) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Invalid payload format');
        }

        if (!$this->validator->validateDeviceData($deviceData)) {
            return $this->errorResponse(422, 'Validation failed');
        }

        $flags = $this->resolveFlags($deviceData);
        $this->logger->logSync($deviceData['device_id'] ?? 'unknown');

        return $this->successResponse($flags);
    }

    /**
     * Parse XML payload with security controls.
     * Applies libxml options based on configuration.
     */
    private function parseXmlPayload(string $xml): ?array
    {
        // Base security flags - disable network access
        $libxmlFlags = LIBXML_NONET;

        // Apply DTD policy from parser options
        if (!$this->parserOptions['allow_dtd']) {
            $libxmlFlags |= LIBXML_DTDLOAD | LIBXML_DTDATTR;
        }

        // Critical: configure entity loading behavior
        $entityLoaderState = $this->configureEntityLoader();

        try {
            $doc = new \DOMDocument('1.0', $this->parserOptions['encoding']);
            $doc->strictErrorChecking = true;
            $doc->resolveExternals = false;

            // Use internal error handling
            $previousErrors = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);

            $result = $doc->loadXML($xml, $libxmlFlags);

            if (!$result || $this->hasXmlErrors()) {
                return null;
            }

            // Validate document structure
            if (!$this->validateXmlStructure($doc)) {
                return null;
            }

            return $this->domToArray($doc->documentElement);
        } finally {
            $this->restoreEntityLoader($entityLoaderState);
            libxml_use_internal_errors($previousErrors ?? false);
            libxml_clear_errors();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Configure entity loader based on security policy.
     * Returns previous state for restoration.
     */
    private function configureEntityLoader(): bool
    {
        $previousState = true;

        // Feature flag: xml_entity_expansion controls entity processing
        // When disabled (default), we block external entity loading
        // When enabled, allows internal entity expansion for legacy clients
        $allowEntities = $this->featureFlags->isEnabled('xml_entity_expansion');

        if (PHP_VERSION_ID < 80000) {
            // PHP 7.x: use libxml_disable_entity_loader
            // Note: parameter is "disable" - true means disabled
            // SECURITY: Always disable entity loader regardless of feature flag
            $previousState = libxml_disable_entity_loader(true);
        } else {
            // PHP 8.x: entity loader is disabled by default
            // Feature flag has no effect on 8.x - safe by default
            $previousState = false;
        }

        return $previousState;
    }

    /**
     * Restore entity loader to previous state.
     */
    private function restoreEntityLoader(bool $previousState): void
    {
        if (PHP_VERSION_ID < 80000) {
            libxml_disable_entity_loader($previousState);
        }
    }

    private function hasXmlErrors(): bool
    {
        $errors = libxml_get_errors();
        foreach ($errors as $error) {
            if ($error->level === LIBXML_ERR_FATAL) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function validateXmlStructure(\DOMDocument $doc): bool
    {
        $root = $doc->documentElement;
        if ($root === null || $root->nodeName !== 'device_config') {
            return false;
        }

        // Check nesting depth
        if ($this->getMaxDepth($root) > $this->parserOptions['max_depth']) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function getMaxDepth(\DOMNode $node, int $current = 0): int
    {
        $max = $current;
        foreach ($node->childNodes as $child) {
            if ($child->nodeType === XML_ELEMENT_NODE) {
                $depth = $this->getMaxDepth($child, $current + 1);
                $max = max($max, $depth);
            }
        }
        return $max;
    }

    private function domToArray(\DOMElement $element): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($element->childNodes as $child) {
            if ($child->nodeType === XML_ELEMENT_NODE) {
                $value = $child->childNodes->length === 1 && 
                         $child->firstChild->nodeType === XML_TEXT_NODE
                    ? $child->textContent
                    : $this->domToArray($child);
                $result[$child->nodeName] = $value;
            }
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function resolveFlags(array $deviceData): array
    {
        $platform = $deviceData['platform'] ?? 'unknown';
        $version = $deviceData['app_version'] ?? '0.0.0';
        $segment = $deviceData['user_segment'] ?? 'default';

        return $this->featureFlags->getFlagsForContext([
            'platform' => $platform,
            'version' => $version,
            'segment' => $segment,
        ]);
    }

    private function parseJsonPayload(string $json): ?array
    {
        $data = json_decode($json, true, $this->parserOptions['max_depth']);
        return is_array($data) ? $data : null;
    }

    private function successResponse(array $flags): array
    {
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'flags' => $flags, 'timestamp' => time()];
    }

    private function errorResponse(int $code, string $message): array
    {
        http_response_code($code);
        return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => $message];
    }
}

/**
 * Feature Flags service - reads from environment/config
 */
class FeatureFlags
{
    private $flags;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->flags = [
            'legacy_xml_compat' => getenv('FF_LEGACY_XML_COMPAT') === 'true',
            'xml_entity_expansion' => getenv('FF_XML_ENTITY_EXPANSION') === 'true',
            'dark_mode' => true,
            'push_v2' => true,
            'offline_sync' => false,
        ];
    }

    public function isEnabled(string $flag): bool
    {
        return $this->flags[$flag] ?? false;
    }

    public function getFlagsForContext(array $context): array
    {
        $result = $this->flags;
        // Platform-specific overrides
        if (($context['platform'] ?? '') === 'ios') {
            $result['haptic_feedback'] = true;
        }
        return $result;
    }
}
